cd /workspace/tmp && cat > z3test3.py <<'EOF'
import z3, time
x = z3.Int('x'); y = z3.Int('y')
for pri in ['lex','box','pareto']:
    opt = z3.Optimize()
    opt.set(priority=pri)
    opt.add(x>=0, x<=100, y>=0, y<=100, x+y<=50)
    h1 = opt.minimize(x)
    h2 = opt.maximize(y)
    r=opt.check()
    print(pri, r, 'x:',opt.lower(h1), opt.upper(h1), 'y:', opt.lower(h2), opt.upper(h2))
# separate optimize calls
opt = z3.Optimize()
opt.add(x>=0,x<=100,y>=0,y<=100,x+y<=50)
h1=opt.minimize(x); opt.check(); print('min x', opt.lower(h1), opt.upper(h1))
opt2 = z3.Optimize()
opt2.add(x>=0,x<=100,y>=0,y<=100,x+y<=50)
h2=opt2.maximize(x); opt2.check(); print('max x', opt2.lower(h2), opt2.upper(h2))
EOF
